Restore Database

Warning: Restoring will overwrite the current database with the selected backup. After restore completes, the app will automatically upgrade the database for compatibility. A restart is usually not required, but is safe if you see anything odd.

Choose a .db backup file from your computer to restore from.

The file stays on your machine; it is uploaded only for the restore operation.
This will copy user accounts from the uploaded DB into the current DB (insert/update by username).
Recommended. The app will keep your current database schema and import data table-by-table only when it is compatible. Incompatible tables are skipped to avoid breaking the application.
If unchecked, the app will pre-validate the uploaded DB and block restore when required tables/columns are missing or integrity check fails.
